cards.ex: The company has committed to reducing its carbon footprint by 50% by 2030.
cards.exUz: Kompaniya 2030 yilga kelib uglerod izini 50% ga kamaytirishga sodiq qolgan.
cards.uzDef: Biror ishni qilishga qat'iy qaror qilib, o'sha ishni qilishga va'da berish.

cards.ex: I resent having to work overtime every weekend just to make ends meet.
cards.exUz: Men har hafta oxiri pul topish uchun qo'shimcha ishlashimga nafratlanaman.
cards.uzDef: Biror ishni qilishga majbur bo'lganingizda g'azablanish yoki norozi bo'lish.

cards.ex: She was reluctant to share her personal experiences with the group.
cards.exUz: U o'zining shaxsiy tajribalarini guruh bilan baham ko'rishga istamadi.
cards.uzDef: Nimadir qilishga xohish yo'qligi, istamaslik yoki ikkilanish.

cards.ex: He made an effort to learn a few phrases in Uzbek before visiting Tashkent.
cards.exUz: U Toshkentga tashrif buyurishdan oldin o'zbek tilida bir nechta iboralarni o'rganishga harakat qildi.
cards.uzDef: Biror narsaga erishish uchun qat'iy harakat qilish, urinish.

cards.ex: I make it a point to call my grandmother every Sunday.
cards.exUz: Men har yakshanba kuni buvimga qo'ng'iroq qilishni odat qilaman.
cards.uzDef: Nimadir doimiy ravishda qilishga qaror qilish, odatga aylantirish.

cards.ex: I was tempted to skip the meeting, but I knew I shouldn't.
cards.exUz: Men yig'ilishni o'tkazib yuborishga vasvasaga tushdim, lekin bilardimki, bunday qilmasligim kerak.
cards.uzDef: Nimadir qilish istagi paydo bo'lish, lekin bu noto'g'ri bo'lishi mumkin.

cards.ex: The movie wasn't great, but it was just about bearable watching.
cards.exUz: Film juda yaxshi emas edi, lekin tomosha qilishga arziydi.
cards.uzDef: Biror ishni qilishga toqat qilish, unga chidash.

cards.ex: After all that hard work, you deserve to be recognized for your achievements.
cards.exUz: Shuncha mehnatdan so'ng, siz yutuqlaringiz uchun e'tirof etilishga haqlisiz.
cards.uzDef: Nimagadir loyiq bo'lish, biror mukofotga yoki e'tirofga sazovor bo'lish.

cards.ex: I was thrilled to hear that I got the job.
cards.exUz: Men ishga qabul qilinganimni eshitib juda xursand bo'ldim.
cards.uzDef: Nimadir qilishdan juda xursand bo'lish, hayajonlanish.

cards.ex: I take pleasure in reading a good book on a rainy day.
cards.exUz: Yomg'irli kunda yaxshi kitob o'qishdan rohatlanaman.
cards.uzDef: Biror ishni qilishdan zavqlanish, qoniqish his qilish.

cards.ex: I'm dying to try that new Uzbek restaurant downtown.
cards.exUz: Men shaharning markazidagi yangi o'zbek restoranini tatib ko'rish uchun o'lishga tayyorman.
cards.uzDef: Nimadir qilishni juda xohlash, juda qiziqish.

cards.ex: I'm inclined to agree with your assessment of the situation.
cards.exUz: Men vaziyatga bergan bahoingizga qo'shilishga moyilman.
cards.uzDef: Nimadir qilishga moyillik bo'lish, biror narsani qilish ehtimoli yuqori bo'lish.

cards.ex: It's time to get down to doing some serious studying for the exam.
cards.exUz: Imtihonga jiddiy tayyorgarlik ko'rish vaqti keldi.
cards.uzDef: Biror ishni boshlash, unga diqqatni qaratish.

cards.ex: Switching to solar energy is worth considering, given the rising electricity prices.
cards.exUz: Elektr narxlari ko'tarilayotganini hisobga olsak, quyosh energiyasiga o'tishni o'ylab ko'rishga arziydi.
cards.uzDef: Biror narsani o'ylab ko'rish, baholash kerak.

cards.ex: If we don't protect endangered species, they will eventually cease to exist.
cards.exUz: Agar biz yo'qolib borayotgan turlarni himoya qilmasak, ular oxir-oqibat yo'q bo'lib ketadi.
cards.uzDef: Mavjud bo'lishni to'xtatish, yo'qolish.

cards.ex: He studied hard in hopes of getting a scholarship.
cards.exUz: U stipendiya olish umidida qattiq o'qidi.
cards.uzDef: Nimadir qilish umidida, biror maqsadga erishish uchun.

cards.ex: I object to being treated unfairly by my boss.
cards.exUz: Men boshlig'im tomonidan adolatsiz munosabatda bo'lishimga qarshiman.
cards.uzDef: Biror ishga rozi bo'lmaslik, qarshilik ko'rsatish.

cards.ex: The company is making a move to expand its operations overseas.
cards.exUz: Kompaniya o'z faoliyatini chet elda kengaytirish uchun harakat qilmoqda.
cards.uzDef: Biror narsa qilish uchun harakat qilish, qadam qo'yish.

cards.ex: She is dedicated to helping children with special needs.
cards.exUz: U o'zini maxsus ehtiyojli bolalarga yordam berishga bag'ishlagan.
cards.uzDef: Biror ishga o'zini to'liq bag'ishlash, fidoyilik ko'rsatish.

cards.ex: We anticipate launching the new product in the spring.
cards.exUz: Biz yangi mahsulotni bahorda ishga tushirishni oldindan kutmoqdamiz.
cards.uzDef: Biror ishning bo'lishini oldindan bilish, kutish.

cards.ex: I'm prone to procrastinating when I have a lot of work to do.
cards.exUz: Menda ko'p ish bo'lsa, kechiktirishga moyilman.
cards.uzDef: Biror ishni tez-tez qilishga moyillik bo'lish, odatda shunday qilish.

cards.ex: I relish the thought of spending a week relaxing on the beach.
cards.exUz: Men bir hafta davomida plyajda dam olish haqida o'ylashdan zavqlanaman.
cards.uzDef: Biror ishni qilishdan katta zavq olish, tatib ko'rish.

cards.ex: I've made a habit of exercising every morning before work.
cards.exUz: Men har kuni ertalab ishdan oldin mashq qilishni odat qildim.
cards.uzDef: Biror ishni doimiy ravishda qilishni odatga aylantirish.

cards.ex: She is intent on becoming a doctor.
cards.exUz: U shifokor bo'lishga qasd qilgan.
cards.uzDef: Biror ishni qilishga qat'iy qaror qilish, maqsad qilmoq.

cards.ex: The new law is set to go into effect next month.
cards.exUz: Yangi qonun keyingi oy kuchga kirishi kerak.
cards.uzDef: Biror ishni qilishga tayyor bo'lish, rejalashtirilgan bo'lish.

cards.ex: He claims to be an expert in Uzbek literature, but I'm not so sure.
cards.exUz: U o'zini o'zbek adabiyoti bo'yicha mutaxassis deb da'vo qiladi, lekin men bunga ishonmayman.
cards.uzDef: O'zini biror kim yoki nimadir deb da'vo qilmoq.

cards.ex: The experiment proved to be a success.
cards.exUz: Tajriba muvaffaqiyatli bo'lib chiqdi.
cards.uzDef: Natijada nimadir bo'lib chiqish, ma'lum bo'lish.

cards.ex: I struggle to understand complex grammatical rules.
cards.exUz: Men murakkab grammatik qoidalarni tushunishda qiynalaman.
cards.uzDef: Biror ishni qilishda qiyinchiliklarga duch kelish.

cards.ex: They were destined to meet, even though they lived on opposite sides of the world.
cards.exUz: Ular dunyoning qarama-qarshi tomonlarida yashashsa ham, uchrashishga taqdir qilingan edi.
cards.uzDef: Taqdir bo'yicha sodir bo'lishi kerak bo'lgan narsa.

cards.ex: I was reluctant to lend him money again, but he promised to pay me back this time.
cards.exUz: Men unga yana pul berishni istamagan edim, lekin u bu safar qaytarib berishga va'da berdi.
cards.uzDef: Nimadir qilishga xohish yo'q, lekin shunga qaramay harakat qilish.
